These terms cover the SYNQ Studios website (synqstudios815.com) and SYNQ Poster, an internal tool SYNQ Studios uses to upload short video clips to its own YouTube channel.

SYNQ Poster

SYNQ Poster is not a public product and has no outside users. It is operated only by SYNQ Studios, on our own computer, to publish videos we edited ourselves to the YouTube channel we own. It uses YouTube API Services; use of YouTube through it is subject to the YouTube Terms of Service and the Google Privacy Policy. How data is handled is described in our Privacy Policy.

Our content

We only upload clips we have permission to post, made under the rules of the creator campaigns we take part in, and we follow YouTube's Community Guidelines.

This website

The website is information about our recording studio. Session bookings are made through Square and are subject to Square's terms and our studio policies given at booking.
